status: Espen approved the recommended actions and implementation with PR #20 merge on October 26, 2026. These are selected working budget allocations and design directions, not adoption of an illustrative tax schedule or a solvency certification.
units: Nominal $T FY2030–39 except CAP surge is a lifetime envelope and early_admin_bn is $B shifted from FY2030 to FY2029, not additional lifetime funding. IRS risk is a reduction in expected receipts, not spending.

architecture.default_budget_view: Total federal current-law revenue, spending, debt and program changes, with fund/GF detail and explicit state/local limitations
architecture.education: Full adopted scope; mixed payroll/public financing with reserve corridor and public backstop; exact rate, share and statutory corridor parameters await joint settlement
architecture.income_financing: Replace C19b in the preferred redesign; develop coordinated income financing and refundable contribution relief; retain C19b only in the historical/funded comparator until the replacement is priced
architecture.social_security: Preserve benefits, complete high-income base reforms including SS-5; later broad-rate closer remains a tested alternative, not selected
architecture.hi: Develop explicit general-fund support with calibrated annual HI data; the 0.35-point illustration is not an actuarially verified adopted amount
architecture.leave: Repair high-take-up financing with a 1.10-point working contribution ceiling and the existing gradual adjustment mechanism
architecture.participation: DOL-led practical access to work, education, training and community participation with accommodations, without work conditions on basic assistance or proof of AI causation
architecture.climate: Retain existing credit budget while developing a common-baseline marginal-value comparison of grid, adaptation, workforce and subsidy allocations
architecture.delivery: Protect adjudication, payment systems, enforcement and access to remedies; explicit notice, appeal, accessible assistance and continuity of essential benefits
architecture.courts: Remove CRT-16 automatic expansion trigger; retain term-limit/amendment development and fresh democratic decisions on later structural responses
architecture.care: Develop all-age basic home support plus prolonged intensive-care protection, retaining stronger Medicaid services

not_selected: Either complete illustrative tax schedule or solver-derived broad income rate
$300 or $1500 universal credit instead of the coordinated protection design
The 2-point broad Social Security closer, a final HI grant amount or an education contribution rate/public share
Exact new housing award count, administrative launch dates, other agency allocations or state matching revisions
Relaxation of D3/D4, automatic recession benefit cuts, deployment or outside contact
standing_authority: Espen retains project-goal decisions; project coworker may decide project elements in service of those goals. All PR #20 recommendations accepted, latest controlling conflicts; open issues with no recommended action retain options. No communication with other humans on Espen’s behalf.

capacity_allocation.units: nominal $B; lifetime surge, FY2030-39 sustained; inside existing envelopes

housing_admin_basis: HOU-4A: $12.2B rounded planning correction on whole $150B package, fully permanent CPI path; inside total housing cost, separate from CAP. HOU-4D remains fixed $135B, no award count adopted.
